reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text:
I’ve used 5-0 Police Scanner for a long time and it used to be a solid, reliable app for listening to local scanner traffic. The interface is simple, streams are easy to find, and when it works, it does exactly what it promises.

Unfortunately, the recent addition of frequent popup ads has made the app genuinely annoying to use. The popups interrupt listening, disrupt navigation, and take away from what should be a straightforward experience. Ads are understandable in a free app, but the current implementation feels excessive and intrusive.

Overall, it’s still a useful scanner app, but the aggressive popup ads significantly hurt usability and enjoyment. If the ad experience were toned down, this would easily be a much better app again.

reviews.title: Was great before the ads
reviews.text:
Updated review:  I was able to remove the ads b/c I had done a on-time purchase years ago. I see no way to do that if you are a new user. Subscriptions & ads are still ruining it, but I’ve held off on deleting it. 
—-
Used to be one of the best scanner apps out there. Then the ads came along. I’ll gladly tolerate banner ads. I’ll gladly pay a small one-time fee to the developer to get rid of them. But these are full screen and hard to dismiss, and the fee is a $10 subscription. 

Wanna know a secret?  All of these scanner apps are just front ends for the Broadcastify feeds which you can get for free in a browser. I’m saving my money and deleting the app. Too bad. I used to like this app until the ads took over.
